name: HitKeep Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted web analytics software with cookieless traffic tracking, events, goals, funnels, ecommerce reports, Search Console integration, AI visibility, custom tracking domains, and team SSO; no software seat or usage quota published.
watch_out: Requires your own server, storage, backups, HTTPS and operational maintenance; optional external integrations or AI services may incur costs. The separately managed HitKeep Cloud plan is not included. Self-hosted installation uses a local Go binary or Docker Compose with embedded DuckDB and NSQ.
